name: profile
description: Probe router model, firmware variant, and auto-detect HTTP session/token encryption.

name: status
description: WAN IP, gateway, DNS servers, uptime, cellular network type, and connection state.

name: signal
description: Real-time radio telemetry: RSRP (dBm), RSRQ (dB), SINR (dB), RSSI, Band (B1/B3/B8/B20/B40).

name: cell-lock
description: Force-lock modem to specific carrier band (e.g., Band 3 1800MHz) or Physical Cell ID (PCI).

name: set-mode
description: Switch cellular RAT between AUTO, 4G_ONLY, 3G_ONLY, and 5G_NSA to prevent 3G drops.

name: apn
description: Read or update APN profile (e.g. Hutch 'hutch3g' / 'net'), PDP type (IPv4/IPv6), and auth.

name: sms-list
description: List SIM card inbox messages, extract 2FA verification codes, view sender, and timestamp.

name: sms-send
description: Transmit SMS message via the SIM modem to activate cellular bundles or query balance.

name: ussd
description: Send interactive USSD codes to carrier gateway for instant balance checks and reloads.

name: wifi-status
description: Display 2.4GHz & 5GHz SSID status, channel number, bandwidth (20/40/80MHz), and encryption.

name: wifi-channel
description: Change broadcast channel to avoid apartment RF congestion (e.g., Channels 1, 6, 11).

name: clients
description: List all connected LAN/Wi-Fi devices with MAC addresses, hostnames, assigned IPs, and bandwidth.

name: reboot
description: Cleanly restart router OS and modem module without touching physical reset pin.

name: reconnect
description: Disconnect and reconnect WAN cellular session to trigger new CGNAT IP lease.

name: optimize-network
description: Apply/Revert kernel BBR, 1420 MTU clamping, Cloudflare 1.1.1.1 DNS, and TCP buffer sizes.

name: pulse
description: Background UDP keepalive daemon that keeps 4G tower carrier states active indefinitely.

name: repl
description: Interactive shell session with tab-completion, live signal meters, and history navigation.

name: benchmark
description: Run latency jitter, packet fragmentation tests, and bufferbloat grade evaluation.
